questions.q: Which two scenarios are the main reasons Receivables stores a customer's bank account details?
options: Direct debit / automatic receipts, and electronic refunds
Printing invoices and calculating tax
Assigning a salesperson and setting a credit limit
Creating a transaction type and a memo line
questions.explain: Most receipts simply arrive without needing bank details on file in advance; automatic receipts and refunds are the two cases that do.

questions.q: A customer bank account is associated with which level of the customer structure?
options: A single account site only
The party, so it can be reused across more than one of that party's customer accounts
A single transaction
The ledger
questions.explain: Bank accounts are tied to the party, similar to how a party can have multiple addresses, and can be authorized for use by multiple customer accounts.

questions.q: What must already exist before a customer bank account can be entered in Receivables?
options: A completed credit check
A signed payment term agreement
The bank and bank branch, as shared setup data used across Oracle Fusion
A merged customer record
questions.explain: Receivables references the same shared bank and branch setup used by Cash Management and Payables rather than maintaining its own separate list.

questions.q: In the Cascade Outdoor Supply example, what changed once the bank account was set up and authorized?
options: Cascade's credit limit was automatically increased
Cascade's invoices were automatically written off
Cascade was merged into a different customer account
Northwind's automatic receipt process could pull the due amount directly from Cascade's account on the due date
questions.explain: Once authorized, automatic receipts could pull payment directly from the customer's bank account rather than waiting for a manual wire.

questions.q: Which scenario could also use a customer's bank account on file?
options: Issuing an electronic refund for an overpayment
Setting the customer's tax classification
Creating a new transaction type
Assigning a collector
questions.explain: Refunds owed to the customer, such as for an overpayment or large credit, can be sent electronically to the bank account on file.
